proposals.before: At the beginning of Tongzhi, on recommendation of Chinese and foreign ministers, he was appointed intendant of the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu circuit in Henan, served as provincial treasurer, and was promoted to Governor-General of the Eastern Rivers.
proposals.after: At the beginning of Tongzhi, on recommendation of capital and provincial ministers, he was appointed intendant of the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu circuit in Henan, served as provincial treasurer, and was promoted to Governor-General of the Eastern Rivers.
proposals.reason: 中外大臣 means inner/outer court (capital and provincial) officials, not Chinese and foreign ministers.

proposals.before: After mourning for his parents he was appointed vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
proposals.after: After a period of mourning he was appointed vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
proposals.reason: 遭憂 does not specify both parents; idiomatic invents "parents".

proposals.before: After mourning for his parents he was made supervising secretary.
proposals.after: After a period of mourning he was made supervising secretary.
proposals.reason: 遭憂 does not specify both parents; idiomatic invents "parents".

decisions.reason: s0168 has 以中外大臣薦. In Qing official usage 中外大臣 means capital and provincial high officials, not Chinese and foreign ministers; the proposed wording corrects that mistranslation.

s0080 says 遭憂歸，服闋, which marks entry into mourning and its completion but does not name both parents; idiomatic 'mourning for his parents' invents that detail, and the proposed wording removes it without adding new error.
s0152 says 遭憂去官，服闋, likewise without specifying both parents; removing invented 'parents' restores fidelity while keeping a natural idiomatic appointment clause.
